text:
Andrea: Heads-up — planning to deploy engine-runtime v2.14 + quant-profile 'q8_fast' to production tonight 22:00 PST. Owners: Sam (deploy), Maria (smoke), Jonah (rollback).
Sam: Ack. I'll do the deploy. Can we do a 10% canary for 1h then promote?
Andrea: Yes, canary 10% for 60m then gradual ramp over 30m if metrics stable.
Ashwin: What are the guardrails? Latency/throughput thresholds?
Maria: Smoke checklist I'll run:
- run smoke request: 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"smoke: latency ping"}' \
    https://inference.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.status'
- expect 200 within 400ms and p95 <= 350ms
- token generation rate should be >= 250 tokens/s on canary nodes
- verify KV cache hit-rate not dropping >5% vs baseline
Sam: Deploy command I'll run (dry-run first):
```
redwoodctl deploy --env prod --image engine:2.14 --quant q8_fast --canary 10 --timeout 3600
```
Jonah: Rollback quick steps:
```
redwoodctl rollback --env prod --to engine:2.13
kubectl -n prod annotate deployment/runtime rollback-by=jonah-1769504321
```
CI-Bot: [deploy plan check] All preflight checks passed (images available, infra quota ok).
Maria: I'll run smoke tests at +15m after canary starts and paste results.
Sam: Starting canary at 22:00 PST. I'll ping here when pods are up.
CI-Bot: [deploy] Canary started for engine:2.14 (10% traffic) at 1769505600
Maria: Smoke 1 results: 200 OK, p50 120ms, p95 310ms, tokens/s 270, KV hit-rate stable. Link: https://logs.redwood.ai/job/1769505600
Ashwin: Quick perf note — seeing small increase in GPU SM utilization (~5%) on canary nodes, seems fine.
Sam: Promoting to 50% now, will monitor for 15m before full promote.
CI-Bot: [deploy] Traffic ramp to 50% at 1769506600
Maria: Smoke 2 (50%) results: p95 330ms, no errors, N=1200 requests.
Jonah: Rollback still ready. No action needed.
Sam: Promoted to 100% at 1769507800. Monitoring dashboard normal.
Andrea: Thanks team — if anyone sees issues react here. Postmortem if any regressions.
Maria: All clear from smoke side. :thumbsup:
Jonah: Marking rollback hooks cleared. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Closing thread, tagging release notes entry.
